notes: All 394 printed subject rows / 336 family-card identities across 15 sections retain physical Character, Subject, Property, First Name, Last Name, Character Name, Team, Division and unlabelled DEBUT fields. All 200 base numbers and the 30 MLBH-31 through MLBH-60 team assignments remain as printed; teams are blank outside the jersey program. Repeated dual, triple and quad actor/character rows retain every signer. BASE CARDS labels the unheaded first table; no rookie flags or absent Property values are inferred. All 54 Sapphire odds preserve literal 01:14:00, 1:26854 and Padpradascha spelling. The Sapphire format is published but no ratio unit is named; box contents do not establish per-pack odds. Named serial limits and an exact release date are unverified; no regular Chrome numbering is copied into Sapphire.
The inspected official product page, regional store and launch listing do not establish an exact calendar release date. Product year 2026 and checklist availability remain separate from release date.

Named serial-number limits are not stated in the linked checklist or the inspected product descriptions. Sapphire limits are not copied from regular Chrome or prior years. Exhaustive numbering remains unverified.

The odds header names Sapphire but no ratio unit; all 54 ratios remain literal. White Sapphire prints 01:14:00; do not interpret or repair it as 1:14. Preserve Padpradascha spelling and the unpunctuated Quad Facsimile value 1:26854.
The first 200-row table prints Character and Property but no family caption; BASE CARDS is an adapter label grounded in the product page's explicit 200-card base set description.

Twenty base rows print DEBUT in a separate unlabelled field; it is not a Rookie column. Preserve blank Property fields in Beauty and the Beast and facsimile families; no values are filled from theme or character identity.
